lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਬੇ ਕਮਾਏ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: purabe kamaae sreera(n)g paae har mile chiree vichhu(n)niaa ||
lines.translation: By my past actions, I have found the Lord, the Greatest Lover. Separated from Him for so long, I am united with Him again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਰਬਤਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਬਿਸੁਆਸੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar baahar sarabat raviaa man upajiaa bisuaaso ||
lines.translation: Inside and out, He is pervading everywhere. Faith in Him has welled up within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੋ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sikh dei man preetam kar sa(n)taa sa(n)g nivaaso ||4||
lines.translation: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, let the Society of the Saints be your dwelling. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man piaariaa jeeu mitraa har prem bhagat man leenaa ||
lines.translation: O dear beloved mind, my friend, let your mind remain absorbed in loving devotion to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੀਵੇ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man piaariaa jeeu mitraa har jal mil jeeve meenaa ||
lines.translation: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the fish of the mind lives only when it is immersed in the Water of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੀ ਆਘਾਨੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੇ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮਨ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har pee aaghaane a(n)mrit baane srab sukhaa man vuthe ||
lines.translation: Drinking in the Lord's Ambrosial Bani, the mind is satisfied, and all pleasures come to abide within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਪਾਏ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sreedhar paae ma(n)gal gaae ichh pu(n)nee satigur tuthe ||
lines.translation: Attaining the Lord of Excellence, I sing the Songs of Joy. The True Guru, becoming merciful, has fulfilled my desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੜਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਲਾਏ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਉ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: laR leene laae nau nidh paae naau sarabas thaakur deenaa ||
lines.translation: He has attached me to the hem of His robe, and I have obtained the nine treasures. My Lord and Master has bestowed His Name, which is everything to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਸਮਝਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੫॥੧॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sikh sa(n)t samajhaaee har prem bhagat man leenaa ||5||1||2||
lines.translation: Nanak instructs the Saints to teach, that the mind is imbued with loving devotion to the Lord. ||5||1||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗ ਕੇ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag ke chha(n)t mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Chhants Of Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dakhanaa ||
lines.translation: Dakhanaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਠ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਦੀਦਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: hath majhaahoo maa piree pase kiu deedaar ||
lines.translation: My Beloved Husband Lord is deep within my heart. How can I see Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਲਭਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t saranaaee labhane naanak praan adhaar ||1||
lines.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Saints, O Nanak, the Support of the breath of life is found. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਮਨਿ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal siu preet reet sa(n)tan man aavae jeeu ||
lines.translation: To love the Lotus Feet of the Lord-this way of life has come into the minds of His Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ਅਨੀਤਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਨਹ ਭਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: duteeaa bhaau bipareet aneet daasaa nah bhaavae jeeu ||
lines.translation: The love of duality, this evil practice, this bad habit, is not liked by the Lord's slaves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਾ ਨਹ ਭਾਵਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਾਵਏ ਇਕ ਖਿਨੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: daasaa nah bhaavae bin darasaavae ik khin dheeraj kiu karai ||
lines.translation: It is not pleasing to the Lord's slaves; without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, how can they find peace, even for a moment?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੀਨਾ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਜਿਉ ਮਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam bihoonaa tan man heenaa jal bin machhulee jiu marai ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the body and mind are empty; like fish out of water, they die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil mere piaare praan adhaare gun saadhasa(n)g mil gaavae ||
lines.translation: Please meet with me, O my Beloved-You are the Support of my breath of life. Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ke suaamee dhaar anugrahu man tan a(n)k samaavae ||1||
lines.translation: O Lord and Master of Nanak, please grant Your Grace, and permeate my body, mind and being. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dakhanaa ||
lines.translation: Dakhanaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਹੰਦੜੋ ਹਭ ਠਾਇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਡੂਜੜੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: soha(n)daRo habh thaai koi na disai doojaRo ||
lines.translation: He is Beautiful in all places; I do not see any other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੁਲੑੜੇ ਕਪਾਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khulhRe kapaat naanak satigur bhetate ||1||
lines.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, O Nanak, the doors are opened wide. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਪਾਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਆਧਾਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere bachan anoop apaar sa(n)tan aadhaar baanee beechaareeai jeeu ||
lines.translation: Your Word is Incomparable and Infinite. I contemplate the Word of Your Bani, the Support of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਸੁਆਸ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: simarat saas giraas pooran bisuaas kiu manahu bisaareeai jeeu ||
lines.translation: I remember Him in meditation with every breath and morsel of food, with perfect faith. How could I forget Him from my mind?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬੇਸਾਰੀਐ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਟਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਣਵੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu manahu besaareeai nimakh nahee taareeai gunava(n)t praan hamaare ||
lines.translation: How could I forget Him from my mind, even for an instant? He is the Most Worthy; He is my very life!

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man baa(n)chhat phal det hai suaamee jee kee birathaa saare ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master is the Giver of the fruits of the mind's desires. He knows all the useless vanities and pains of the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਕੇ ਨਾਥੇ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੇ ਜਪਿ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: anaath ke naathe srab kai saathe jap jooai janam na haareeai ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Patron of lost souls, the Companion of all, your life shall not be lost in the gamble.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)tee prabh pahi kripaa kar bhavajal taareeai ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak offers this prayer to God: Please shower me with Your Mercy, and carry me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dakhanaa ||
lines.translation: Dakhanaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੂੜੀ ਮਜਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਖੇ ਸਾਈ ਥੀਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhooRee majan saadh khe saaee theee kripaal ||
lines.translation: People bathe in the dust of the feet of the Saints, when the Lord becomes merciful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਧੇ ਹਭੇ ਥੋਕੜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ladhe habhe thokaRe naanak har dhan maal ||1||
lines.translation: I have obtained all things, O Nanak; the Lord is my Wealth and Property. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਧਾਮ ਭਗਤਹ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਆਸਾ ਲਗਿ ਜੀਵਤੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)dar suaamee dhaam bhagatah bisraam aasaa lag jeevate jeeu ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master's Home is beautiful. It is the resting place of His devotees, who live in hopes of attaining it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨੇ ਗਲਤਾਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਤੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tane galataan simarat prabh naam har a(n)mrit peevate jeeu ||
lines.translation: Their minds and bodies are absorbed in meditation on the Name of God; they drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar.
